about: Frozen development challenge added before the readiness fixes. Authored by Codex from existing source scope; not independent human acceptance. Excerpt cases require relevant evidence, not a claim of full answer certainty. Changed 2026-11-12, when the University of Tennessee documents were retired: the six cases built on them were replaced. Three now check that a UT question is withheld; three check excerpts from the federal forklift standard.
